# Pull Request Template for Awesome OSINT

Thank you for contributing to Awesome OSINT! Please fill out the following checklist to help us review your submission efficiently.

## Submission Checklist

### For New Tool/Resource Additions:
- [ ] I have read the [CONTRIBUTING.md](./CONTRIBUTING.md) guidelines
- [ ] The tool/resource is **alphabetically sorted** within its category
- [ ] I have used the correct format: `[Tool Name](URL) - Brief description.`
- [ ] The link has been verified to work
- [ ] The title uses proper [capitalization](http://grammar.yourdictionary.com/capitalization/rules-for-capitalization-in-titles.html)
- [ ] I have checked for duplicates (searched existing entries)
- [ ] The tool is relevant to OSINT investigations
- [ ] My pull request has a descriptive title

### Required Information:
**Tool/Resource Name**: 

**Category/Section**: 

**URL**: 

**Description**: 

**Pricing Model**: 
- [ ] Free
- [ ] Freemium  
- [ ] Paid
- [ ] Open Source

**Additional Details**:
- Requires API Key: [Yes/No]
- Actively Maintained: [Yes/No]
- Any warnings or limitations: 

### Disclosure (if applicable):
- [ ] I am NOT affiliated with this tool/resource
- [ ] I AM affiliated with this tool/resource (please explain below):

**Affiliation Details** (if applicable):


---

## Examples

### ✅ Good Submission:
```markdown
* [Perplexity](https://www.perplexity.ai) - AI-powered search engine with source citations.
```

### ❌ Bad Submissions:
```markdown
* [perplexity](https://www.perplexity.ai) - cool ai tool  (incorrect capitalization, vague description)
* [Perplexity](https://www.perplexity.ai)  (no description)
* [Perplexity AI Search Engine Tool](https://www.perplexity.ai) - Amazing tool for everything (overly promotional)
```

---

## Response Time Expectations

- We aim to review all pull requests within **7-14 days**
- Incomplete submissions may take longer or be closed
- Be patient and respectful - maintainers are volunteers!

## Questions?

If you have any questions about your submission, feel free to ask in the comments or open an issue.

Thank you for helping make Awesome OSINT better! 🎉
